name: Thomas Unruh
source:
[i]"Ninja's my savior!"[/i]

[i]Zealous Monomaniac[/i]

He was worked to the bone at his first job but was saved by the chivalrous thief Ninja from dying by overwork.

He subsequently became one of his biggest fans. As a result of his nighttime searches for his idol, though, he tends to doze during work.

[From [url=https://products.voltage.co.jp/tempest/fd/english/characters/]Voltage Inc.[/url]]
